{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, underestimating bull market momentum and overestimating bear market declines.",
    "Sentiment positively biases forecasts when sentiment shifts from negative to neutral, correcting otherwise conservative estimates.",
    "Mean reversion bias exists in model forecasts, causing overshooting when prices deviate significantly from historical ranges.",
    "Forecasts converge toward historical mean levels when price volatility decreases, missing recent momentum shifts.",
    "Sentiment exhaustion (repeated identical sentiments) indicates model failure to capture nuanced market shifts.",
    "Model confidence intervals narrow too aggressively, showing unrealistic forecast uncertainty reduction.",
    "When price has strong upward momentum (3+ consecutive gains), model forecasts underperform by 0.5-1.0% relative to true outcomes."
] }
